text: {"translations": {"fr": "Tu me manques tellement, la maison est vide sans toi.", "es": "Te extraño muchísimo, la casa está vacía sin ti.", "it": "Mi manchi tantissimo, la casa è vuota senza di te.", "en": "I miss you so much, the house feels empty without you."}, "feeling": ["longing", "love", "care"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "ddar khawya bla bik", "literal": "the house is empty without you", "meaning": "a common Moroccan way to express how deeply someone's absence is felt at home — the house is not literally empty, but emotionally so."}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.es: Te extraño muchísimo, la casa está vacía sin ti.
translations.it: Mi manchi tantissimo, la casa è vuota senza di te.

cultural_notes.literal: the house is empty without you

text: {"translations": {"fr": "Que Dieu te protège et te donne la réussite dans tes études, mon cœur.", "es": "Que Dios te guarde y te haga triunfar en tus estudios, mi vida.", "it": "Che Dio ti protegga e ti dia successo nei tuoi studi, tesoro mio.", "en": "May God protect you and grant you success in your studies, my dear."}, "feeling": ["blessing", "care", "love"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "lah y7fdek", "literal": "May God protect you", "meaning": "A very common Moroccan prayer/blessing (du3a) used by elders; it carries deep affection and is almost always paired with a wish for success."}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Que Dieu te protège et te donne la réussite dans tes études, mon cœur.
translations.es: Que Dios te guarde y te haga triunfar en tus estudios, mi vida.
translations.it: Che Dio ti protegga e ti dia successo nei tuoi studi, tesoro mio.

cultural_notes.meaning: A very common Moroccan prayer/blessing (du3a) used by elders; it carries deep affection and is almost always paired with a wish for success.

text: {"translations": {"fr": "Mon cœur, qui veut le miel doit accepter les piqûres des abeilles.", "es": "Hijo mío, quien quiere miel debe aguantar las picaduras de las abejas.", "it": "Tesoro mio, chi vuole il miele deve sopportare le punture delle api.", "en": "My dear, you can't have the honey without the bee stings."}, "feeling": ["care", "love"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el", "literal": "Whoever wants honey must endure the sting of bees", "meaning": "A proverb teaching that worthwhile rewards require patience through hardship — a grandmother's gentle way of saying 'no pain, no gain.'"}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Mon cœur, qui veut le miel doit accepter les piqûres des abeilles.
translations.es: Hijo mío, quien quiere miel debe aguantar las picaduras de las abejas.
translations.it: Tesoro mio, chi vuole il miele deve sopportare le punture delle api.

cultural_notes.expression: lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el
cultural_notes.literal: Whoever wants honey must endure the sting of bees

text: {"translations": {"fr": "Tu as grandi comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !", "es": "¡Has crecido como una palmera, pero todavía no sabes cocinar!", "it": "Sei cresciuto come una palma, ma non sai ancora cucinare!", "en": "You've grown tall like a palm tree, but you still don't know how to cook!"}, "feeling": ["pride", "humor", "love"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "b7al nkhla", "literal": "like a palm tree", "meaning": "A very common Moroccan comparison for someone who has grown tall; palm trees are iconic in Morocco and used affectionately to describe stature"}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Tu as grandi comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !
translations.es: ¡Has crecido como una palmera, pero todavía no sabes cocinar!
